g.text: Initial A:0.25 search budget | learning rate 0.001 | seed 92601 | primary V_select
Negative (blue): B2 lower error. Positive (orange): B2 higher error. Gray: empty group; no value imputed.
n = active channels; equal-channel group mean. Each nonzero panel has its own symmetric scale; no cross-dataset pooling.
Matched whole-method comparison, not P-only causation, demonstrated convergence, or independent generalization.
